title: SS28 Toddler Girls' Trending Trims Report
summary: SS28 kidswear trims: flat seams, embroidery, printed UPF labels, secure snaps.
research_period: SS28 previews published November 2025 to November 2026; SS27 runway record

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. SS28 kidswear fairs (Pitti Bimbo and Playtime) take place in June 2027. This report projects from SS28 adult previews, the SS27 kidswear fair record and long-term drivers such as heat and UV protection, and will be updated after the fairs.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Milano Unica's SS28 theme "Metamorphosis" rests on Lightness, Enrichment ("the rediscovery of handcrafted techniques") and Adaptability, with LIGHTWEAR, HANDWEAR and TECHWEAR themes<sup>[1]</sup>
- Future Snoops' SS28 performance preview: "smart translucent membranes, hyperlight wovens, and innovative technical silks", ultrastretch wovens, modular constructions and articulated seams<sup>[2]</sup>

sections.heading: Trims table
sections.body:
| Trim | Application | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Snaps | Rompers | Core |
| Printed labels | All | Core |

design_implications:
- Wash-test every trim. No small detachable parts for under-3s.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
